rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` has skill front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material. It requires each such link to say when to read the file. I checked every link in the file:

- **`references/fixme.md`:** the "Fixing findings" table row says to read it for "a real gap the user agrees to defer, a FIXME judgment, or a `{fixme}` issue that closed".
- **`references/reviews.md`:** the table row says to read it for a "false citation or site review".
- **`references/authoring-failures.md`:** the Gotchas bullet says to read it "If authoring fails on configuration, credentials, throttling, or a denied mandatory input".
- **`../habeas/references/ci.md`:** the "Testing and coverage findings" section introduces it with "For CI integration, recommend the separate collection and check steps in the Habeas CI example". That scopes the link to a situation, CI integration. It is the least explicit of the four, but it still says when the file applies.

Every link carries a when-to-read condition, so I found no gap.
